title: Department of Computing & Information Technology
description: PRE-REQUISITES:INFO 1600ORCOMP1600COURSE DESCRIPTION This course provides an overview of current ethical standards and practices in the computing and information technology area. Students will develop an awareness of both the ethical and legal issues facing the computerized workplace. The course will be delivered using a combination of lectures, eLearning, case studies and various online resources.  Assignments will take the form of written examinations, group projects and presentations. ASSESSMENT (No final written examination)
